defect: num_neighbor_elems is read via GetNFaceNeighborElements() before ExchangeFaceNbrData(), so it is 0 (face_nbr_elements not yet built) and x_shared is sized too small for the received data.
reason: The fix moves the read after the exchange, repairing ordering written in this new file; seeing it needs pmesh.hpp, where GetNFaceNeighborElements returns face_nbr_elements.Size().

defect: The fix rewrites the merge-constructor doc comment for the new Mode enum (Full/Hdiv/Hcurl).
reason: Only comments change in the fix; the duplicate parameter names this change introduced had already been fixed by another commit.

defect: The attribute index j is reused as the inner vertex-loop counter and only incremented per rank, so attr_ne[j] reads the wrong attributes; the send is also guarded by ne instead of nc.
reason: The fix adds a separate counter m incremented per element and corrects the guard, all in lines this change added.

defect: The fix replaces the variable-length array dummy_vertex[spaceDim] with a heap allocation.
reason: The VLA existed before this change as dummy_vertex[Dim]; the change only changed its size expression.

defect: pkv_map[pkv] = pkv_map[pkv_other] overwrites an existing link of pkv instead of uniting the two sets, so earlier unions are lost and knot vectors that should be identified get different roots.
reason: The fix replaces this assignment with a proper union-find unite(); the faulty linking was added by this change.

defect: The TETRAHEDRON case has no break and falls through into the HEXAHEDRON case, reading verts[4..7] of a tet, and the hex face edge ordering is wrong.
reason: The fix rewrites both cases, adding the missing break and new hex face ordering, in code this change added.

defect: The 256-byte name buffers are one byte short of NC_MAX_NAME+1.
reason: The buffer size was already 256 before this change, which only renamed buf_size to buffer_size and made it const instead of constexpr.

defect: The fix renames the local fes in LegacyAssembleSystem to fes_lor because it shadows the member fes.
reason: A shadowing warning with the same value is style, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix removes the local order in FormCoordinateVectors, which shadows the member with the same value.
reason: This is a shadowing-warning cleanup with no behaviour change.

defect: The I array is allocated with size entries, but the CSR row pointer needs size+1 and h_I[ndofs] is written, a heap overflow.
reason: The fix changes New(size) to New(size+1) on the line this change added.

defect: The fix generalizes the convergence-rate formula from log(2) to a dofs-based rate for non-uniform refinement.
reason: This is a feature or generalization of code that predates this change, which only renamed local variables.

defect: The fix removes qvdim, which is unused when assert is compiled out.
reason: This is an unused-variable warning cleanup, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix resets the preconditioner sign s for prob 2 from -1 back to 1 and initializes s, along with pre-existing boundary-condition changes.
reason: The prob-2 sign line came from this change, but a preconditioner sign affects only convergence and the repository does not show whether -1 was wrong.

defect: SetSpace is declared inline in qfunction.hpp but defined in qfunction.cpp; the fix moves the definitions into the header.
reason: The inline-declared, cpp-defined SetSpace already existed before this change, which only changed the parameter type.

defect: The new constructors index &data[0] and &data[vsize] even when data is null on an empty rank.
reason: The fix replaces these indexing expressions, including the SetData lines this change added (though the pattern was copied from existing constructors).

defect: The fix removes the inner Vector w declaration, which shadows the outer one.
reason: This is a compiler-warning (shadowing) cleanup with no behaviour change.

defect: The new miniapp does not compile: the typo ector, a trailing comma in a parameter list, undefined speed, mesh and dudt, a wrong ODE constructor call, and the wrong Step signature.
reason: The fix repairs these errors, all in the file this change created.

defect: The fix corrects the typo 'in DEVICE' to 'is DEVICE' in three abort messages.
reason: A message wording fix is not a functional defect.

defect: The J copy for HYPRE_BigInt is guarded only by HYPRE_BIGINT, so the mixed-int build passes an int* as HYPRE_BigInt*.
reason: The test already failed to build under mixed-int before this change (int rows/cols/J), so this change only partly fixed a pre-existing break and did not introduce it.

defect: The new k1 and k2 formulas use 2*pm1 instead of 2*pm2, giving out-of-range or wrong face DOF permutations (for p=2, k1=2 with only 2 DOFs).
reason: The fix replaces pm1 with pm2 in exactly the two lines this change added.

defect: PA.C0.HostWrite() was moved before SetSize, so after the reallocation the host values are written to memory that is not marked valid on the host.
reason: The fix moves HostWrite back after each SetSize, undoing this change's reordering.

defect: The fix deletes a dead #if 0 alternative of the MFEM_REGISTER_TMOP_KERNELS macro.
reason: Removing dead preprocessor code is cleanup.

defect: The fix removes the unused constexpr MQ1 and MD1 from the outer kernel scope.
reason: This is an unused-variable warning cleanup.

defect: In FGMRES the monitor's updated solution is built with Update(x_monitor, i, H, s, v), but FGMRES's search directions are z, not v.
reason: The fix changes v to z in the line this change added.

defect: NewL2(..., mesh->NURBSext) dereferences the serial mesh after it was deleted (use after free); it should use pmesh.
reason: The fix replaces mesh with pmesh in the line this change added.

defect: The fix makes ProjectBdrCoefficient correct in parallel when the DOF owner has no adjacent boundary element, by accumulating and counting values.
reason: The parallel issue predates this change, which only added null-coefficient skips.

defect: The #ifdef MFEM_USE_ALGOIM guard covers only the include, while the class uses blitz::TinyVector and Algoim types, so builds without Algoim fail to compile.
reason: The fix extends the guard over the whole namespace, which this change created unguarded.

defect: The fix corrects knot-removal formulas in KnotRemove for multiple removals and makes cosmetic VERIFY-to-ASSERT and whitespace changes.
reason: The repaired KnotRemove code was not touched by this change (dof ownership, renames).

defect: The pyramid vertex count uses nx*nx*nz instead of nx*ny*nz, and the center vertex index VTXP(x, y+1, z+1) is offset instead of VTXP(x, y, z).
reason: The fix corrects both lines, which this change added.

defect: The fix passes a Table::Mode (H_DIV_BND or H_CURL_BND) for boundary DOF table merging to support H(curl) NURBS spaces.
reason: This is new functionality for curl spaces; the bool false used for div was not a defect of this change in the lines the fix touches.

defect: The fix replaces the bool merge flag with a Mode enum that adds H_CURL_BND merging.
reason: This is an API extension and feature, not a repair of this change's logic.

defect: The fix renames the local copies vdim and coeff_vdim to nc and cvdim because they shadow the members.
reason: This is a shadowing-warning cleanup with no behaviour change.

defect: The cuSPARSE path is taken whenever useCuSparse is set (on by default), even when the device is not CUDA, so host data goes to cuSPARSE or, without CUDA, the multiply is skipped.
reason: The fix restores the Device::Allows(CUDA_MASK) check this change removed.

defect: NonconformingTransposeInterpolation loops over only the non-conforming faces but uses the loop index as the face index into d_x instead of conf.face_index.
reason: The fix uses nc_face for the config and conf.face_index for the data in the loop this change rewrote.

defect: InitBasisWithIndices keys on indices[0] but builds the basis through InitTensorBasis/InitNonTensorBasis, which use fes.GetFE(0), the wrong element for index subsets on mixed meshes.
reason: The fix adds WithIndices variants that use indices[0]; InitBasisWithIndices is new in this change.

defect: The fix raises the PCG iteration limit, fixes comment typos and removes a slow sample run.
reason: These are tuning and documentation changes, not a repair of a defect in this change.

defect: The fix repairs SetTimeStep's dt = dt and calls of SetTime instead of SetTimeStep, and replaces the hardcoded optimizer choice with an -opt option.
reason: The dt bugs were pre-existing context; this change's hardcoded if(false) was replaced by an option, which is a feature.

defect: The 3D lexicographic face DOF maps for hex faces 0, 1 and 4 have the reversed in-face orientation relative to MFEM's face vertex ordering, so the normals are wrong.
reason: The fix reverses the i index in exactly these face maps, which this change introduced; seeing it needs hex_t::FaceVert.

defect: The default BilinearFormIntegrator::AssembleTraceFaceMatrix is defined with an extra test_fe2 parameter that does not match the declared virtual signature, so it does not compile.
reason: The fix corrects the signature of the definition this change added; the mismatch shows only against bilininteg.hpp and the derived overrides.

defect: The adjset group names and neighbor lists use GroupTopology local neighbor indices instead of global ranks.
reason: The same use of group_nbrs existed before; this change only replaced the memcpy/std::sort with Array::Sort, keeping the semantics.
